problemStatement.formal: aeval A p = aeval A (p modulo A.charpoly); A^k = aeval A (X^k modulo charpoly)
problemStatement.plain: Every polynomial function of an n×n matrix A reduces to a polynomial of degree < n via Cayley-Hamilton.
whyMatters: Reduces A^100 to degree < n polynomial

proven: Degree bound: reduced poly has degree < n
